1.explanation: The error states that the 'traces gatherer' did not run, which affects all performance metrics. The gatherers are central to collecting the required browser trace events. The files in 'core/gather/' (specifically runner-helpers.js, navigation-runner.js, timespan-runner.js, snapshot-runner.js) orchestrate the gathering process and trigger trace collection. 'core/gather/driver/' interacts with Chrome and is responsible for starting/stopping tracing. The files in 'core/computed/metrics/' implement calculations that depend on trace data—if traces aren't gathered, these computations will fail. Thus, these files are highly likely to either contain or be impacted by the bug.
1.bug_scenario: The bug scenario shows a Lighthouse performance audit where all key metrics (First Contentful Paint, Speed Index, Time to Interactive, First Meaningful Paint, First CPU Idle, and Max Potential First Input Delay) fail with 'Required traces gatherer did not run' errors. Opportunities and diagnostics sections also report errors for all items. This indicates a core tracing/gathering mechanism in the runtime failed, leading to missing performance metrics and diagnostics.
